reason: Gated behind `if https && ...` in generate_security_issues — analyze_security's own `https` flag comes from the literal URL scheme (`url.starts_with("https://")`), and analyze_security builds its reqwest client with `.danger_accept_invalid_certs(false)`, so a self-signed local TLS fixture would fail certificate validation by design (the same hardening this check exists to verify), not serve as a usable test double. Needs a CA-trusted local cert to exercise for real.

audit_source_maps fetches the page HTML, extracts <script src> asset URLs, then fetches each asset and its sibling .map file as separate HTTP requests to separate paths. The current fixture server (serve_with_headers in tests/security_detection_corpus_test.rs) always returns one fixed response regardless of request path, so it can't serve distinct page/asset/map responses. Needs a path-routing fixture server (same gap noted for the WCAG corpus's multi-page cases, see plan/ backlog) before this check can be exercised.
